name: Siteimprove Analytics
description: Allows your site to be tracked by Siteimprove Analytics by adding a Javascript tracking code to every page.
project_description:
Siteimprove Analytics allows your site to be tracked by Siteimprove Analytics by adding a Javascript tracking code to every page.

 The Siteimprove Analytics script will only be added if the code can be found,

the user is anonymous, and the path does not match the following values:

 
 /admin* 
 /batch* 
 /node/add* 
 /node/*/edit 
 /node/*/delete 
 /user/*/edit* 
 /user/*/cancel* 
 
 Back to top 

 SIMILAR MODULES 
 This is a simple module with very little configuration. Enable it, add your code and you're done. If you're looking for the Siteimprove popup overlay features, you want the Siteimprove module .

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit mode installation documentation for further information.

 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 Add your Siteimprove Analytics code by going to the settings under: /admin/config/system/siteimprove-analytics. You can also add the

code to your settings.php with the following line:

 $config['siteimprove_analytics.settings']['code'] = XXXXXXX;
